messages:
nora: quick pass on chart visuals — proposing: compact legend for narrow panels, standard unit copy, a tiny smoothing toggle, and explicit outlier markers. sharing a figma link. :link:

ash: looks good. for legend: when width < 380px collapse to `Series (N)` menu. otherwise show inline with small color swatch + label. allow 'pin' to keep important series visible.

irene: accessibility: do not rely on color alone. each swatch needs an icon or shape option and `aria-pressed` when hidden. axis labels should have full-word aria titles like `Median latency (milliseconds)`; visible label can be `Latency (ms)`.

maria: units: let's standardize on `requests/sec` in the UI (not `rps` or `req/s`). for latency keep `ms` visually but add description on hover.

ash: smoothing: Off | Light (EMA, alpha=0.12) | Strong (alpha=0.3 with outlier damp). default Off. if cap mode used, hover must show raw + displayed values.

irene: outliers: prefer marking with hollow markers + tooltip `outlier: > 99.9th percentile`. avoid silently capping by default.

nora: timeline: can we get a small interactive prototype by Friday? @ash can you scope the legend + smoothing toggle interactions?

ash: yep, will do a lightweight prototype and include keyboard flows.

design-bot: ux-checklist updated: legend-collapse, aria-axis-titles, unit-copy, smoothing-toggle, outlier-badges. :white_check_mark:
